Report_ID: Family caregiver burden, FBIS/FIBS total score at post-1
Title: Evaluation of a psychoeducation program for Chinese clients with schizophrenia and their family caregivers
Author: Chan et al.
Comment: The paper reports endpoint means and SDs at post-1 but no numerical post-1 pairwise test result or reported mean difference. M_diff and SE_diff are therefore left null; use the raw arm-level endpoint data for meta-analysis. Post-2 and post-3 values were excluded because they fall outside the requested window. The instrument is called FBIS in Methods but FIBS in Results/Table 4.; group_1/group_2 fields swapped: the extractor itself stated group_1_label ('Experimental group: 10-session psychoeducation program plus routine care') is the intervention arm (group_1_is_control=False)
Design Type: Randomized controlled trial with repeated follow-up assessments
domain: Family psychoeducation for schizophrenia; caregiver burden
Study Environment: Psychiatric outpatient department of a regional mental hospital
Topic of Content: Schizophrenia, treatment, coping, communication, family burden, services, and relapse warning signs
interaction_type: Clients and family caregivers attended psychoeducation sessions together
Participant type: Family caregivers of clients with schizophrenia
Recruitment source: Psychiatric outpatient department of a regional mental hospital in Hong Kong
Outcome measurement: End-of-intervention caregiver-reported FBIS/FIBS total score; higher scores indicate greater burden of care
Outcome variable: Family caregiver burden, FBIS/FIBS total score at post-1
effect_direction: Lower scores indicate less burden; intervention minus control MD < 0 favors intervention.

Title: Effect of a psycho-educational intervention for family members on caregiver burdens and psychiatric symptoms in patients with schizophrenia in Shiraz, Iran
Author: Sharif, Shaygan, and Mani
Comment: The table reports 13.03 ± 5.74 and 18.34 ± 6.5 but the supplied paper text does not explicitly identify the ± values as SD or SE. Under the anti-hallucination rule, neither was entered as an SD or SE, so this row cannot contribute to inverse-variance MD pooling without clarification from the original formatted table or authors. The paper lists the intervention arm first; therefore M_diff was not populated because the extraction schema defines it as group_2 minus group_1, whereas the review requires intervention minus control. The directly calculable review-oriented endpoint contrast is 13.03 minus 18.34, but it is intentionally not stored because it is not reported verbatim and the required variability is unresolved.; group_1/group_2 fields swapped: the extractor itself stated group_1_label ('Experimental group: caregiver family psychoeducation plus antipsychotic treatment for the patient') is the intervention arm (group_1_is_control=False); unsupported or insufficient statistic type
Design Type: Randomized controlled trial with repeated assessments and blinded assessor
domain: Schizophrenia family psychoeducation and caregiver burden
Study Environment: Three psychiatric centers in Shiraz; outpatient patients and their primary family caregivers
Medium: Ten in-person 90-minute group psychoeducational sessions over five weeks
Topic of Content: Schizophrenia education, medication and adherence, relapse prevention, communication, symptom management and coping, emotion, stress management, and relaxation
interaction_type: Family caregiver group psychoeducation with lectures, question-and-answer periods, and group discussion
Participant type: Primary family caregivers of outpatients diagnosed with schizophrenia
Recruitment source: Records of patients with schizophrenia available at three psychiatric centers in Shiraz
Outcome measurement: End-of-intervention total Family Burden questionnaire score measured immediately after the five-week programme
effect_direction: Lower scores indicate less burden; intervention minus control MD < 0 favors intervention.

Report_ID: Total adjusted BAS score at end of intervention
Title: Impact of brief psychosocial intervention on key relatives of patients with schizophrenia: A randomized controlled trial
Author: Rajneesh Kumar et al.
Comment: Per the synthesis contract, immediate post-intervention endpoint values were extracted because both arms reported endpoint means and SDs. The paper’s t=3.001 and P=0.004 compare change scores (BPI 11.29 ± 8.52 vs NCI 4.65 ± 6.26), not the endpoint means, so they were not attached as the endpoint test statistic. M_diff is stored according to the extraction schema as group 2 minus group 1 (NCI − BPI = 58.00 − 59.63 = −1.63); for the review’s requested intervention-minus-control convention, the corresponding raw MD is +1.63 BAS points.; group_1/group_2 fields swapped: the extractor itself stated group_1_label ('Brief psychosocial intervention (BPI) group') is the intervention arm (group_1_is_control=False)
Study Environment: Tertiary care center in North India
Medium: In-person individual psychoeducation and caregiver group sessions
Content length: Two one-hour individual psychoeducation sessions one week apart, followed by six 60–90 minute group sessions every two weeks within 3 months
Topic of Content: Schizophrenia education, expressed emotion, relatives' role, medication and adherence, clinical resources, problem solving, coping, communication, and caregiver support
interaction_type: Individual psychoeducation followed by open caregiver group therapy/support
Participant type: Key relatives who had cared for patients with schizophrenia for at least 1 year
Outcome measurement: Total adjusted Burden Assessment Schedule score
Outcome variable: Total adjusted BAS score at end of intervention
effect_direction: Higher BAS scores indicate greater burden; intervention minus control MD < 0 favors intervention. Here the endpoint MD is positive, favoring control.

Title: Effectiveness of Psychoeducation and Mutual Support Group Program for Family Caregivers of Chinese People with Schizophrenia
Author: Wai Tong Chien
Comment: The reported F(1,66)=4.32 is the repeated-measures group-by-time result, not a Time-2-only contrast. The p-value is reported only as p<.01; 0.01 records the reported threshold, not an exact p-value. M_diff was left null because the paper does not directly report a Time-2 mean difference and its arm order places intervention in group 1; the synthesis can calculate intervention minus control from the extracted endpoint means (24.69 - 28.49 = -3.80) without reversing the table’s arm order. The paper inconsistently states that 64 families signed consent while reporting random assignment and Table 3 sample sizes of n=34 per arm; the table/ITT analysis Ns were retained.; group_1/group_2 fields swapped: the extractor itself stated group_1_label ('Psychoeducation and mutual support group plus conventional psychiatric outpatient care') is the intervention arm (group_1_is_control=False)
Design Type: Randomized controlled trial with repeated measures and intention-to-treat analysis
domain: Family intervention for schizophrenia; caregiver burden
Medium: In-person psychoeducation and mutual support group
Content length: 36 weeks; 18 biweekly sessions; about two hours per session
Topic of Content: Schizophrenia education, caregiving and patient-management skills, coping, problem solving, communication, social support, and mutual aid
